statement: On GitHub Release published events only, .github/workflows/publish.yml publishes @nessalabs/spec-ledger, @nessalabs/spec-ledger-client, and @nessalabs/spec-ledger-server at version equal to the release tag (0.1.0-alpha.0 line) to the nessalabs npm org/registry; pull_request and push must not publish; workflow_dispatch may dry-run; NPM_TOKEN is required for live publish and documented in the workflow.
rationale: Release is the only publish trigger; dry-run proves the path without cutting a release in-bet.
